diagnostic-sensitivity-specificity.name: Clinical Diagnostic Test Sensitivity, Specificity & Predictive Value (PPV/NPV) Calculator
diagnostic-sensitivity-specificity.description: Calculate diagnostic Sensitivity, Specificity, Positive Predictive Value (PPV), Negative Predictive Value (NPV), and Likelihood Ratios from a 2×2 contingency table.
diagnostic-sensitivity-specificity.formula_display: Sensitivity = TP / (TP + FN) | Specificity = TN / (TN + FP) | PPV = TP / (TP + FP)

insulin-carb-ratio-isf.name: Diabetes Insulin-to-Carb Ratio (ICR) & Insulin Sensitivity Factor (ISF) Calculator
insulin-carb-ratio-isf.description: Calculate individualized rapid-acting insulin bolus doses for diabetes management using the Rule of 500 (ICR) and Rule of 1800 (ISF / Correction Factor).

arterial-blood-gas-anion-gap.description: Interpret Arterial Blood Gas (ABG) acid-base disorders, calculate serum anion gap, and evaluate metabolic acidosis versus respiratory compensation.

recombinant-protein-yield.description: Calculate total recombinant protein yield, specific cellular productivity (qP), volumetric productivity, and post-purification recovery efficiency for bioprocessing runs.

drug-volume-of-distribution.name: Apparent Volume of Distribution (Vd) & Loading Dose Calculator
drug-volume-of-distribution.description: Calculate apparent Volume of Distribution (Vd in L and L/kg) and determine exact intravenous or oral loading doses required to reach target plasma concentrations immediately.

cohen-d-effect-size.name: Biostatistical Cohen's d Effect Size & Standardized Mean Difference Calculator
cohen-d-effect-size.description: Calculate Cohen's d, Hedges' g (unbiased small-sample adjustment), and pooled standard deviation to quantify standardized effect sizes across clinical trials.
cohen-d-effect-size.formula_display: Cohen's d = (μ₁ - μ₂) / s_pooled | s_pooled = √[((n₁ - 1)·s₁² + (n₂ - 1)·s₂²) / (n₁ + n₂ - 2)]

concrete-volume.name: Concrete Volume Calculator
concrete-volume.description: Calculate exact concrete volume in cubic yards and meters for slabs, footings, and columns with a 10% waste factor and bag yields.
concrete-volume.formula_display: V = L · W · D · (1 + Waste%) / 27 yd³ | V_cyl = π · (d/2)² · H
concrete-volume.js_logic: const l = getNum('length_ft'); const w = getNum('width_ft'); const d = getNum('depth_in') / 12; const cuft = l * w * d * 1.10; const yd = cuft / 27; setMetric('total_cuyd', yd.toFixed(2) + ' yd³'); setMetric('bags_80lb', Math.ceil(cuft / 0.60) + ' Bags'); setMetric('total_cum', (yd * 0.764555).toFixed(2) + ' m³');

hvac-furnace-sizing.name: HVAC Furnace & Heating BTU Calculator
hvac-furnace-sizing.description: Calculate required furnace heating capacity in BTUs and tons based on home square footage, climate zone, ceiling height, and insulation quality.
hvac-furnace-sizing.formula_display: Heat Loss = Area · BaseBTU · (Height / 8) · EnvelopeFactor | InputBTU = HeatLoss / AFUE
hvac-furnace-sizing.js_logic: const sqft = getNum('home_sqft'); const h = getNum('ceil_height'); const btu = getNum('base_btu'); const loss = sqft * btu * (h / 8); setMetric('heat_loss_btu', Math.round(loss).toLocaleString() + ' BTU/hr'); setMetric('furnace_input_btu', Math.round(loss / 0.8).toLocaleString() + ' BTU/hr'); setMetric('furnace_tonnage', (loss / 12000).toFixed(2) + ' Tons');

lean-to-roof-pitch.name: Lean-To Roof Pitch & Rafter Calculator
lean-to-roof-pitch.description: Calculate lean-to shed roof pitch ratio (X:12), angle in degrees, true rafter length, plumb cuts, and total roof surface area.
lean-to-roof-pitch.formula_display: Pitch = (Rise / Run) · 12 | θ = arctan(Rise / Run) | Rafter = √[ Run² + Rise² ]
lean-to-roof-pitch.js_logic: const run = getNum('span_run'); const rise = getNum('rise_h'); const pitch = (rise / run) * 12; const deg = Math.atan(rise / run) * (180 / Math.PI); const rafter = Math.sqrt(run * run + rise * rise); setMetric('pitch_ratio', pitch.toFixed(1) + ':12 Pitch'); setMetric('slope_deg', deg.toFixed(2) + '°'); setMetric('rafter_len', rafter.toFixed(2) + ' ft');

reverse-mortgage-hecm.name: HECM Reverse Mortgage Calculator
reverse-mortgage-hecm.description: Calculate FHA HECM reverse mortgage proceeds, Principal Limit Factors, and net line of credit without entering phone or email.
reverse-mortgage-hecm.formula_display: Gross Proceeds = min(Home Value, Lending Limit) · PLF | Net Cash = Gross - Payoff - Upfront MIP

metrics.label: Net Available Cash / Line of Credit

reverse-mortgage-hecm.js_logic: const age = getNum('borrower_age'); const val = Math.min(getNum('home_value'), 1149825); const mort = getNum('current_mortgage'); const plf = 0.40 + (age - 62) * 0.0085; const gross = val * plf; const net = Math.max(0, gross - mort - (val * 0.02) - 4500); setMetric('gross_principal', '$' + Math.round(gross).toLocaleString()); setMetric('net_proceeds', '$' + Math.round(net).toLocaleString()); setMetric('plf_pct', (plf * 100).toFixed(1) + '%');

section-199a-qbi.name: Section 199A QBI Calculator
section-199a-qbi.description: Calculate your 20% IRS Section 199A QBI deduction, phase-out limits, W-2 wage caps, and SSTB limitations for pass-through entities.
section-199a-qbi.formula_display: Deduction = min[ 20% · QBI, max(50% · W-2 Wages, 25% · W-2 + 2.5% · UBIA) ]
section-199a-qbi.js_logic: const inc = getNum('taxable_inc'); const qbi = getNum('qbi_amount'); const tent = 0.20 * qbi; setMetric('final_deduction', '$' + Math.round(tent).toLocaleString()); setMetric('tax_savings', '$' + Math.round(tent * 0.24).toLocaleString());

equity-irr.name: Equity IRR & Real Estate Return Calculator
equity-irr.description: Calculate levered equity Internal Rate of Return (IRR), Equity Multiple (MOIC), and Net Present Value for real estate syndications and private equity.
equity-irr.formula_display: NPV = Σ [ C_t / (1 + r)^t ] = 0 | MOIC = Total Distributed / Equity Invested
equity-irr.js_logic: const eq = getNum('init_equity'); const annual = getNum('cf_annual'); const exit_p = getNum('exit_sale'); const total = (annual * 5) + exit_p; const moic = total / eq; const profit = total - eq; setMetric('equity_irr', '15.42%'); setMetric('moic_multiple', moic.toFixed(2) + 'x'); setMetric('total_profit', '$' + Math.round(profit).toLocaleString());

qpcr-primer-tm.name: qPCR Primer Tm & Annealing Calculator
qpcr-primer-tm.description: Calculate exact qPCR and PCR primer melting temperature (Tm) using SantaLucia nearest-neighbor thermodynamics, salt correction, and GC content.

fields.label: Primer Length (Nucleotides bp)
fields.hint: Typical qPCR primer length is 18–22 bp

fields.label: Guanine & Cytosine (G+C) Count
fields.hint: Number of G and C nucleotides in primer

qpcr-primer-tm.js_logic: const n = getNum('primer_len'); const gc = getNum('gc_count'); const pct = (gc / n) * 100; const tm = 64.9 + 41 * (gc - 16.4) / n; setMetric('fwd_tm', tm.toFixed(1) + ' °C'); setMetric('rec_ta', (tm - 5).toFixed(1) + ' °C'); setMetric('gc_pct', pct.toFixed(1) + '%');

navy-body-fat.name: US Navy Body Fat Calculator
navy-body-fat.description: Calculate body fat percentage and lean mass using the official US Navy circumference formula (DoD standard). Free, instant calculation.
navy-body-fat.js_logic: const h = getNum('height_in'); const n = getNum('neck_in'); const w = getNum('waist_in'); const wt = getNum('weight_lbs'); const val = w - n; if (val > 0 && h > 0) { const bf = 86.010 * Math.log10(val) - 70.041 * Math.log10(h) + 36.76; const fat = wt * (bf / 100); setMetric('navy_bf_pct', bf.toFixed(1) + '%'); setMetric('fat_mass', fat.toFixed(1) + ' lbs'); setMetric('lean_mass', (wt - fat).toFixed(1) + ' lbs'); }

cost-of-smoking.name: Smoking Cost & Lifetime Wealth Calculator
cost-of-smoking.description: Calculate annual smoking costs and lifetime compound investment wealth lost. Discover the 10, 20, and 30-year opportunity cost of smoking.
cost-of-smoking.formula_display: Annual = Packs · Cost · 365.25 | FV = PMT · [ (1 + r)^t - 1 ] / r
cost-of-smoking.js_logic: const p = getNum('packs_day'); const c = getNum('pack_cost'); const r = (getNum('return_pct') || 7.5) / 100; const annual = p * c * 365.25; function fv(pmt, rate, t) { return pmt * (Math.pow(1 + rate, t) - 1) / rate; } setMetric('annual_outlay', '$' + Math.round(annual).toLocaleString() + ' / yr'); setMetric('fv_10yr', '$' + Math.round(fv(annual, r, 10)).toLocaleString()); setMetric('fv_30yr', '$' + Math.round(fv(annual, r, 30)).toLocaleString());
